chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:

"Whoever takes his salat (prayer) lightly is not of me; by Allah, he shall not come to me at the Hawdh. No, by Allah, whoever drinks an intoxicant is not of me; he shall not come to me at the Hawdh. No, by Allah."

key_terms.اسْتَخَفَّ: treated lightly, belittled, or showed disregard toward
key_terms.الْحَوْضَ: the Hawdh, the Prophet’s pond in the Hereafter
key_terms.صَلَاتِهِ: his salat (prayer), referring to the obligatory act of worship
key_terms.لَيْسَ مِنِّي: is not of me, meaning not acting in accordance with my way

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say about taking prayer lightly and drinking intoxicants?
ai.summary: This hadith strongly warns against belittling salat (prayer) and consuming intoxicants. It links these grave acts to estrangement from the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله and deprivation from reaching his Hawdh in the Hereafter.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.617 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said:

"Whoever takes their prayer lightly is not of me; by Allah (swt), they will not come to my Hawdh (on the Day of Judgment). By Allah (swt), whoever drinks intoxicants is not of me; by Allah (swt), they will not come to my Hawdh (Pond); no, by Allah (swt)."
